Test Pages › Failure Analysis › Cascading Error
Type B: Test Issue

Cascading Error

Plan options changed: "Basic" was removed and replaced with "Premium", "Business", "Enterprise". An old test selecting "Basic" causes a cascading failure when the confirmation step tries to verify the plan name.

Failure Scenario: previous_step_error

The pricing plans were updated. The "Basic" plan was discontinued and replaced with "Premium".

  • Old plans: Basic ($9/mo), Premium ($29/mo), Enterprise ($99/mo)
  • New plans: Premium ($29/mo), Business ($59/mo), Enterprise ($99/mo)
  • Old test behavior: Step 1: select "Basic" plan. Step 3: verify plan name shows "Basic"
  • Cascading effect: The "Basic" option does not exist, so no plan gets selected. In Step 3, the plan verification fails because no plan was chosen (or wrong plan name appears).
